ayahs.ar: تَنۡزِيۡلُ الۡكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡحَكِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Tanzeelul Kitaabi minal laahil 'Azeezil Hakeem
ayahs.en: The revelation of the Qur'an is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبَ بِالۡحَقِّ فَاعۡبُدِ اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaaa anzalnaaa ilaikal Kitaaba bilhaqqi fa'budil laaha mukhlisal lahud deen
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muhammad], in truth. So worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.

ayahs.ar: اَلَا لِلّٰهِ الدِّيۡنُ الۡخَالِصُؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اَوۡلِيَآءَۘ مَا نَعۡبُدُهُمۡ اِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُوۡنَا٘ اِلَي اللّٰهِ زُلۡفٰيؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ فِيۡ مَا هُمۡ فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ ࣢ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهۡدِيۡ مَنۡ هُوَ كٰذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ
ayahs.tl: Alaa lillaahid deenul khaalis; wallazeenat takhazoo min dooniheee awliyaaa'a maa na'buduhum illaa liyuqar riboonaaa ilal laahi zulfaa; innal laaha yahkumu baina hum fee maa hum feehi yakhtalifoon; innal laaha laa yahdee man huwa kaazibun kaffaar
ayahs.en: Unquestionably, for Allah is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position." Indeed, Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allah does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.

ayahs.ar: لَوۡ اَرَادَ اللّٰهُ اَنۡ يَّتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَّاصۡطَفٰي مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۙ سُبۡحٰنَهٗؕ هُوَ اللّٰهُ الۡوَاحِدُ الۡقَهَّارُ
ayahs.tl: Law araadal laahu aiyattakhiza waladal lastafaa mimmaa yakhluqu maa yashaaa'; Subhaanahoo Huwal laahul Waahidul Qahhaar
ayahs.en: If Allah had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allah, the One, the Prevailing.

ayahs.ar: خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِالۡحَقِّۚ يُكَوِّرُ الَّيۡلَ عَلَي النَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ النَّهَارَ عَلَي الَّيۡلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَؕ كُلٌّ يَّجۡرِيۡ لِاَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّيؕ اَلَا هُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡغَفَّارُ
ayahs.tl: Khalaqas samaawaati wal arda bilhaqq; yukawwirul laila 'alan nahaari wa yukawwirun nahaara 'alaal laili wa sakhkharash shamsa walqamara kulluny yajree li ajalim musammaa; alaa Huwal 'Azeezul Ghaffaar
ayahs.en: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

ayahs.ar: خَلَقَكُمۡ مِّنۡ نَّفۡسٍ وَّاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا وَاَنۡزَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَنۡعَامِ ثَمٰنِيَةَ اَزۡوَاجٍؕ يَخۡلُقُكُمۡ فِيۡ بُطُوۡنِ اُمَّهٰتِكُمۡ خَلۡقًا مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ خَلۡقٍ فِيۡ ظُلُمٰتٍ ثَلٰثٍؕ ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمۡ لَهُ الۡمُلۡكُؕ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۚ فَاَنّٰي تُصۡرَفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Khalaqakum min nafsinw waahidatin summa ja'ala minhaa zawjahaa wa anzala lakum minal-an'aami samaani yata azwaaj; yakhuluqukum fee butooni ummahaatikum khalqam mim ba'di khalqin fee zulumaatin salaas; zaalikumul laahu Rabbukum lahul mulk; laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fa annaa tusrafoon
ayahs.en: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ تَكۡفُرُوۡا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنۡكُمۡࣞ وَلَا يَرۡضٰي لِعِبَادِهِ الۡكُفۡرَۚ وَاِنۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡا يَرۡضَهُ لَكُمۡؕ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِّزۡرَ اُخۡرٰيؕ ثُمَّ اِلٰي رَبِّكُمۡ مَّرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُكُمۡ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ
ayahs.tl: In takfuroo fa innal laaha ghaniyyun 'ankum; wa laa yardaa li'ibaadihil kufra wa in tashkuroo yardahu lakum; wa laa taziru waaziratunw wizra ukhraa; summa ilaa Rabikum marji'ukum fa-yunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon; innahoo 'aleemum bizaatissudoor
ayahs.en: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allah is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا مَسَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهٗ مُنِيۡبًا اِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ اِذَا خَوَّلَهٗ نِعۡمَةً مِّنۡهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدۡعُوۡ٘ا اِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلّٰهِ اَنۡدَادًا لِّيُضِلَّ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِهٖؕ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعۡ بِكُفۡرِكَ قَلِيۡلًاࣗۖ اِنَّكَ مِنۡ اَصۡحٰبِ النَّارِ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa massal insaana durrun da'aa Rabbahoo muneeban ilaihi summa izaa khawwalahoo ni'matam minhu nasiya maa kaana yad'ooo ilaihi min qablu wa ja'ala lillaahi andaadal liyudilla 'ansabeelih; qul tamatta' bikufrika qaleelan innaka min Ashaabin Naar;
ayahs.en: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."

ayahs.ar: اَمَّنۡ هُوَ قَانِتٌ اٰنَآءَ الَّيۡلِ سَاجِدًا وَّقَآئِمًا يَّحۡذَرُ الۡاٰخِرَةَ وَيَرۡجُوۡا رَحۡمَةَ رَبِّهٖؕ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي الَّذِيۡنَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ وَالَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَؕ اِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ اُولُوا الۡاَلۡبَابِࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Amman huwa qaanitun aanaaa'al laili saajidanw wa qaaa'imai yahzarul Aakhirata wa yarjoo rahmata Rabbih; qul hal yastawil lazeena ya'lamoona wallazeena laa ya'lamoon; innamaa yatazakkaru ulul albaab
ayahs.en: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ يٰعِبَادِ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّقُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡؕ لِلَّذِيۡنَ اَحۡسَنُوۡا فِيۡ هٰذِهِ الدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٌؕ وَاَرۡضُ اللّٰهِ وَاسِعَةٌؕ اِنَّمَا يُوَفَّي الصّٰبِرُوۡنَ اَجۡرَهُمۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.tl: Qul yaa 'ibaadil lazeena aamanut taqoo Rabbakum; lillazeena ahsanoo fee haazihid dunyaa hasanah; wa ardul laahi waasi'ah; innamaa yuwaffas saabiroona ajrahum bighayri hisab
ayahs.en: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنِّيۡ٘ اُمِرۡتُ اَنۡ اَعۡبُدَ اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul inneee umirtu an a'budal laaha mukhlisal lahud deen
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.

ayahs.ar: وَاُمِرۡتُ لِاَنۡ اَكُوۡنَ اَوَّلَ الۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa umirtu li an akoona awwalal muslimeen
ayahs.en: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ اِنۡ عَصَيۡتُ رَبِّيۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Qul inneee akhaafu in 'asaitu Rabbee 'azaaba Yawmin 'azeem
ayahs.en: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."

ayahs.ar: قُلِ اللّٰهَ اَعۡبُدُ مُخۡلِصًا لَّهٗ دِيۡنِيۡۚۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qulil laaha a'budu mukhlisal lahoo deenee
ayahs.en: Say, "Allah [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,

ayahs.ar: فَاعۡبُدُوۡا مَا شِئۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِهٖؕ قُلۡ اِنَّ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ الَّذِيۡنَ خَسِرُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ وَاَهۡلِيۡهِمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِؕ اَلَا ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الۡخُسۡرَانُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ
ayahs.tl: Fa'budoo maa shi'tum min doonih; qul innal khaasireenal lazeena khasirooo anfusahum wa ahleehim yawmal qiyaamah; alaa zaalika huwal khusraanul mubeen
ayahs.en: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."

ayahs.ar: لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ فَوۡقِهِمۡ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ النَّارِ وَمِنۡ تَحۡتِهِمۡ ظُلَلٌؕ ذٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اللّٰهُ بِهٖ عِبَادَهٗؕ يٰعِبَادِ فَاتَّقُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Lahum min fawqihim zulalum minan Naari wa min tahtihim zulal; zaalika yukhaw wiful laahu bihee 'ibaadah; yaa 'ibaadi fattaqoon
ayahs.en: They will have canopies of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allah threatens His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اجۡتَنَبُوا الطَّاغُوۡتَ اَنۡ يَّعۡبُدُوۡهَا وَاَنَابُوۡ٘ا اِلَي اللّٰهِ لَهُمُ الۡبُشۡرٰيۚ فَبَشِّرۡ عِبَادِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeenaj tanabut Taaghoota ai ya'budoohaa wa anaabooo ilal laahi lahumul bushraa; fabashshir 'ibaad
ayahs.en: But those who have avoided Taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يَسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ الۡقَوۡلَ فَيَتَّبِعُوۡنَ اَحۡسَنَهٗؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ هَدٰىهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ اُولُوا الۡاَلۡبَابِ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yastami'oonal qawla fayattabi'oona ahsanah; ulaaa'ikal lazeena hadaahumul laahu wa ulaaa'ika hum ulul albaab
ayahs.en: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding.

ayahs.ar: اَفَمَنۡ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِ كَلِمَةُ الۡعَذَابِؕ اَفَاَنۡتَ تُنۡقِذُ مَنۡ فِي النَّارِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Afaman haqqa 'alaihi kalimatul 'azaab; afa anta tunqizu man fin Naar
ayahs.en: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?

ayahs.ar: لٰكِنِ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡا رَبَّهُمۡ لَهُمۡ غُرَفٌ مِّنۡ فَوۡقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَّبۡنِيَّةٌۙ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ ࣢ؕ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِؕ لَا يُخۡلِفُ اللّٰهُ الۡمِيۡعَادَ
ayahs.tl: Laakinil lazeenat taqaw Rabbahum lahum ghurafum min fawqihaa ghurafum mabniyyatun tajree min tahtihal anhaar; wa'dal laah; laa yukhliful laahul mee'aad
ayahs.en: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in [His] promise.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ اَنۡزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَسَلَكَهٗ يَنَابِيۡعَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُ بِهٖ زَرۡعًا مُّخۡتَلِفًا اَلۡوَانُهٗ ثُمَّ يَهِيۡجُ فَتَرٰىهُ مُصۡفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجۡعَلُهٗ حُطَامًاؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرٰي لِاُولِي الۡاَلۡبَابِࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Alam tara annal laaha anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an fasalakahoo yanaabee'a fil ardi summa yukhriju bihee zar'am mukhtalifan alwaanuhoo summa yaheeju fatarahu musfarran summa yaj'aluhoo hutaamaa; inna fee zaalika lazikraa li ulil albaab
ayahs.en: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.

ayahs.ar: اَفَمَنۡ شَرَحَ اللّٰهُ صَدۡرَهٗ لِلۡاِسۡلَامِ فَهُوَ عَلٰي نُوۡرٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖؕ فَوَيۡلٌ لِّلۡقٰسِيَةِ قُلُوۡبُهُمۡ مِّنۡ ذِكۡرِ اللّٰهِؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Afaman sharahal laahu sadrahoo lil Islaami fahuwa 'alaa noorim mir Rabbih; fa wailul lilqaasiyati quloobuhum min zikril laah; ulaaa'ika fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.en: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to [accept] Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah. Those are in manifest error.

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ نَزَّلَ اَحۡسَنَ الۡحَدِيۡثِ كِتٰبًا مُّتَشَابِهًا مَّثَانِيَ تَقۡشَعِرُّ مِنۡهُ جُلُوۡدُ الَّذِيۡنَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡۚ ثُمَّ تَلِيۡنُ جُلُوۡدُهُمۡ وَقُلُوۡبُهُمۡ اِلٰي ذِكۡرِ اللّٰهِؕ ذٰلِكَ هُدَي اللّٰهِ يَهۡدِيۡ بِهٖ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُؕ وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ هَادٍ
ayahs.tl: Allahu nazzala ahsanal hadeesi Kitaabam mutashaa biham masaaniy taqsha'irru minhu juloodul lazeena yakhshawna Rabbahum summa taleenu julooduhum wa quloo buhum ilaa zikril laah; zaalika hudal laahi yahdee bihee mai yashaaa'; wa mai yudlilil laahu famaa lahoo min haad
ayahs.en: Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.

ayahs.ar: اَفَمَنۡ يَّتَّقِيۡ بِوَجۡهِهٖ سُوۡٓءَ الۡعَذَابِ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِؕ وَقِيۡلَ لِلظّٰلِمِيۡنَ ذُوۡقُوۡا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Afamai yattaqee biwaj hihee sooo'al 'azaabi Yawmal Qiyaamah; wa qeela lizzaali meena zooqoo maa kuntum taksiboon
ayahs.en: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَاَتٰىهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Kazzabal lazeena min qablihim fa ataahumul 'azaabu min haisu laa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.

ayahs.ar: فَاَذَاقَهُمُ اللّٰهُ الۡخِزۡيَ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۚ وَلَعَذَابُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ اَكۡبَرُۘ لَوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa azaaqahumul laahul khizya fil hayaatid dunyaa wa la'azaabul Aakirati akbar; law kaanoo ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: So Allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِيۡ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنِ مِنۡ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad darabnaa linnaasi fee haazal Qur-aani min kulli masalil la'allahum yatazakkaroon
ayahs.en: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.

ayahs.ar: قُرۡاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيۡرَ ذِيۡ عِوَجٍ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qur-aanan 'Arabiyyan ghaira zee 'iwajil la'allahum yattaqoon
ayahs.en: [It is] an Arabic Qur'an, without any deviance that they might become righteous.

ayahs.ar: ضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلًا فِيۡهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَاكِسُوۡنَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِّرَجُلٍؕ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيٰنِ مَثَلًاؕ اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Darabal laahu masalar rajulan feehi shurakaaa'u mutashaakisoona wa rajulan salamal lirajulin hal tastawi yaani masalaa; alhamdu lillaah; bal aksaruhum laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: Allah presents an example: a slave owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah! But most of them do not know.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَّاِنَّهُمۡ مَّيِّتُوۡنَؗ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaka maiyitunw wa inna hum maiyitunw wa inna hum maiyitoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكُمۡ تَخۡتَصِمُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Summa innakum Yawmal Qiyaamati 'inda Rabbikum takhtasimoon
ayahs.en: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.

ayahs.ar: فَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنۡ كَذَبَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدۡقِ اِذۡ جَآءَهٗؕ اَلَيۡسَ فِيۡ جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوًي لِّلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Faman azlamu mimman kazaba 'alal laahi wa kazzaba bissidqi iz jaaa'ah; alaisa fee Jahannama maswal lilkaafir
ayahs.en: So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allah and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡ جَآءَ بِالصِّدۡقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهٖ٘ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡمُتَّقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallazee jaaa'a bissidqi wa saddaqa biheee ulaaa'ika humul muttaqoon
ayahs.en: And the one who has brought the truth and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.

ayahs.ar: لَهُمۡ مَّا يَشَآءُوۡنَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡؕ ذٰلِكَ جَزٰٓؤُا الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Lahum maa yashaaa'oona 'inda Rabbihim; zaalika jazaaa'ul muhsineen
ayahs.en: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good -

ayahs.ar: لِيُكَفِّرَ اللّٰهُ عَنۡهُمۡ اَسۡوَاَ الَّذِيۡ عَمِلُوۡا وَيَجۡزِيَهُمۡ اَجۡرَهُمۡ بِاَحۡسَنِ الَّذِيۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Liyukaffiral laahu 'anhum aswa allazee 'amiloo wa yajziyahum ajrahum bi ahsanil lazee kaano ya'maloon
ayahs.en: That Allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.

ayahs.ar: اَلَيۡسَ اللّٰهُ بِكَافٍ عَبۡدَهٗؕ وَيُخَوِّفُوۡنَكَ بِالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖؕ وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ هَادٍۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Alaisal laahu bikaafin 'abdahoo wa yukhawwi foonaka billazeena min doonih; wa mai yudlilil laahu famaa lahoo min haad
ayahs.en: Is not Allah sufficient for His Servant [Prophet Muhammad]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّهۡدِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ مُّضِلٍّؕ اَلَيۡسَ اللّٰهُ بِعَزِيۡزٍ ذِي انۡتِقَامٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa mai yahdil laahu famalahoo mim mudlil; alai sal laahu bi'azeezin zin tiqaam
ayahs.en: And whoever Allah guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allah Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اللّٰهُؕ قُلۡ اَفَرَءَيۡتُمۡ مَّا تَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ اَرَادَنِيَ اللّٰهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلۡ هُنَّ كٰشِفٰتُ ضُرِّهٖ٘ اَوۡ اَرَادَنِيۡ بِرَحۡمَةٍ هَلۡ هُنَّ مُمۡسِكٰتُ رَحۡمَتِهٖؕ قُلۡ حَسۡبِيَ اللّٰهُؕ عَلَيۡهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الۡمُتَوَكِّلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa la'in sa altahum man khalaqas samaawaati wal arda la yaqoolunal laah; qul afara'aitum maa tad'oona min doonil laahi in araadaniyal laahu bidurrin hal hunna kaashi faatu durriheee aw araadanee birahmatin hal hunna mumsikaatu rahmatih; qul hasbiyal laahu 'alaihi tatawakkalul mutawakkiloon
ayahs.en: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides Allah? If Allah intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡمَلُوۡا عَلٰي مَكَانَتِكُمۡ اِنِّيۡ عَامِلٌۚ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul yaa qawmi'maloo 'alaa makaanatikum innee 'aamilun fasawfa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know

ayahs.ar: مَنۡ يَّاۡتِيۡهِ عَذَابٌ يُّخۡزِيۡهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Mai yaateehi 'azaabuny yukhzeehi wa yahillu 'alaihi 'azaabum muqeem
ayahs.en: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالۡحَقِّۚ فَمَنِ اهۡتَدٰي فَلِنَفۡسِهٖۚ وَمَنۡ ضَلَّ فَاِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَاۚ وَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِوَكِيۡلٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa anzalnaa 'alaikal Kitaaba linnaasi bilhaqq; famanih tadaa falinafsihee wa man dalla fa innamaa yadillu 'alaihaa wa maaa anta 'alaihim biwakeel
ayahs.en: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager over them.

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ يَتَوَفَّي الۡاَنۡفُسَ حِيۡنَ مَوۡتِهَا وَالَّتِيۡ لَمۡ تَمُتۡ فِيۡ مَنَامِهَاۚ فَيُمۡسِكُ الَّتِيۡ قَضٰي عَلَيۡهَا الۡمَوۡتَ وَيُرۡسِلُ الۡاُخۡرٰ٘ي اِلٰ٘ي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّيؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allaahu yatawaffal anfusa heena mawtihaa wallatee lam tamut fee manaamihaa fa yumsikul latee qadaa 'alaihal mawta wa yursilul ukhraaa ilaaa ajalim musammaa; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil liqawmai yatafakkarron
ayahs.en: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

ayahs.ar: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ شُفَعَآءَؕ قُلۡ اَوَلَوۡ كَانُوۡا لَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا يَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Amit takhazoo min doonillaahi shufa'aaa'; qul awalaw kaanoo laa yamlikoona shai'aw wa laa ya'qiloon
ayahs.en: Or have they taken other than Allah as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ لِّلّٰهِ الشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِيۡعًاؕ لَهٗ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ ثُمَّ اِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul lillaahish shafaa'atu jamee'aa; lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ardi summa ilaihi turj'oon
ayahs.en: Say, "To Allah belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned."

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا ذُكِرَ اللّٰهُ وَحۡدَهُ اشۡمَاَزَّتۡ قُلُوۡبُ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِۚ وَاِذَا ذُكِرَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اِذَا هُمۡ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa zukiral laahu wahdahush ma azzat quloobul lazeena laa yu'minoona bil Aakhirati wa izaa zukiral lazeena min dooniheee izaa hum yastabshiroon
ayahs.en: And when Allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.

ayahs.ar: قُلِ اللّٰهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ عٰلِمَ الۡغَيۡبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ اَنۡتَ تَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيۡ مَا كَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qulil laahumma faatiras samaawaati wal ardi 'Aalimal Ghaibi washshahaadati Anta tahkumu baina 'ibaadika fee maa kaanoo fee yakhtalifoon
ayahs.en: Say, "O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ اَنَّ لِلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ جَمِيۡعًا وَّمِثۡلَهٗ مَعَهٗ لَافۡتَدَوۡا بِهٖ مِنۡ سُوۡٓءِ الۡعَذَابِ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِؕ وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مَا لَمۡ يَكُوۡنُوۡا يَحۡتَسِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa law anna lillazeena zalamoo maa fil ardi jamee'anw wa mislahoo ma'ahoo laftadaw bihee min sooo'il azaabi Yawmal Qiyaamah; wa badaa lahum minal laahi maa lam yakkoonoo yahtasiboon
ayahs.en: And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allah that which they had not taken into account.

ayahs.ar: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا كَسَبُوۡا وَحَاقَ بِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa badaa lahum saiyiaatu maa kasaboo wa haaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
ayahs.en: And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

ayahs.ar: فَاِذَا مَسَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَاؗ ثُمَّ اِذَا خَوَّلۡنٰهُ نِعۡمَةً مِّنَّاۙ قَالَ اِنَّمَا٘ اُوۡتِيۡتُهٗ عَلٰي عِلۡمٍؕ بَلۡ هِيَ فِتۡنَةٌ وَّلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa izaa massal insaana durrun da'aanaa summa izaa khawwalnaahu ni'matam minna qaala innamaaa ootee tuhoo 'alaa 'ilm; bal hiya fitna tunw wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon Us; then when We bestow on him a favor from Us, he says, "I have only been given it because of [my] knowledge." Rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.

ayahs.ar: قَدۡ قَالَهَا الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَمَا٘ اَغۡنٰي عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qad qaalahul lazeena min qablihim famaaa aghnaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon
ayahs.en: Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.

ayahs.ar: فَاَصَابَهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا كَسَبُوۡاؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مِنۡ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيۡبُهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا كَسَبُوۡاۙ وَمَا هُمۡ بِمُعۡجِزِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa asaabahum saiyi aatu maa kasaboo; wallazeena zalamoo min haaa'ulaaa'i sa yuzeebuhum saiyi aatu maa kasaboo wa maa hum bimu'jizeen
ayahs.en: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be afflicted by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Awalam ya'lamooo annal laaha yabsutur rizqa limai yashaaa'u wa yaqdir; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil liqamai yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Do they not know that Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَسۡرَفُوۡا عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ لَا تَقۡنَطُوۡا مِنۡ رَّحۡمَةِ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغۡفِرُ الذُّنُوۡبَ جَمِيۡعًاؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Qul yaa'ibaadiyal lazeena asrafoo 'alaaa anfusihim laa taqnatoo mirrahmatil laah; innal laaha yaghfiruz zunooba jamee'aa; innahoo Huwal Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

ayahs.ar: وَاَنِيۡبُوۡ٘ا اِلٰي رَبِّكُمۡ وَاَسۡلِمُوۡا لَهٗ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَكُمُ الۡعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنۡصَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa aneebooo ilaa Rabbikum wa aslimoo lahoo min qabli ai yaatiyakumul 'azaabu summ laa tunsaroon
ayahs.en: And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.

ayahs.ar: وَاتَّبِعُوۡ٘ا اَحۡسَنَ مَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَكُمُ الۡعَذَابُ بَغۡتَةً وَّاَنۡتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wattabi'ooo ahsana maaa unzila ilaikum mir Rabbikum min qabli aiyaatiyakumal 'azaabu baghtatanw wa antum laa tash'uroon
ayahs.en: And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive,

ayahs.ar: اَنۡ تَقُوۡلَ نَفۡسٌ يّٰحَسۡرَتٰي عَلٰي مَا فَرَّطۡتُّ فِيۡ جَنۭۡ بِ اللّٰهِ وَاِنۡ كُنۡتُ لَمِنَ السّٰخِرِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: An taqoola nafsuny yaahasrataa 'alaa maa farrattu fee jambil laahi wa in kuntu laminas saakhireen
ayahs.en: Lest a soul should say, "Oh [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allah and that I was among the mockers."

ayahs.ar: اَوۡ تَقُوۡلَ لَوۡ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ هَدٰىنِيۡ لَكُنۡتُ مِنَ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Aw taqoola law annal laaha hadaanee lakuntu minal muttaqeen
ayahs.en: Or [lest] it say, "If only Allah had guided me, I would have been among the righteous."

ayahs.ar: اَوۡ تَقُوۡلَ حِيۡنَ تَرَي الۡعَذَابَ لَوۡ اَنَّ لِيۡ كَرَّةً فَاَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Aw taqoola heena taral 'azaaba law anna lee karratan fa akoona minal muhsineen
ayahs.en: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn so I could be among the doers of good."

ayahs.ar: بَلٰي قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكَ اٰيٰتِيۡ فَكَذَّبۡتَ بِهَا وَاسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ وَكُنۡتَ مِنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Balaa qad jaaa'atka Asyaatee fakazzabta bihaa wastak barta wa kunta minal kaafireen
ayahs.en: But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ تَرَي الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَبُوۡا عَلَي اللّٰهِ وُجُوۡهُهُمۡ مُّسۡوَدَّةٌؕ اَلَيۡسَ فِيۡ جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوًي لِّلۡمُتَكَبِّرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Yawmal Qiyaamati taral lazeena kazaboo 'alallaahi wujoohuhum muswaddah; alaisa fee Hahannama maswal lilmutakabbireen
ayahs.en: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allah [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?

ayahs.ar: وَيُنَجِّي اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡا بِمَفَازَتِهِمۡؗ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوۡٓءُ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yunajjil laahul lazee nat taqaw bimafaazatihim laa yamassuhumus sooo'u wa laa hum uahzanoon
ayahs.en: And Allah will save those who feared Him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍؗ وَّهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ وَّكِيۡلٌ
ayahs.tl: Allaahu khaaliqu kulli shai'inw wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shai'inw Wakeel
ayahs.en: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.

ayahs.ar: لَهٗ مَقَالِيۡدُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡخٰسِرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Lahoo maqaaleedus sa maawaati wal ard; wallazeena kafaroo bi ayaatil laahi ulaaa'ika humul khaasiroon
ayahs.en: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of Allah - it is those who are the losers.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَفَغَيۡرَ اللّٰهِ تَاۡمُرُوۡٓنِّيۡ٘ اَعۡبُدُ اَيُّهَا الۡجٰهِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul afaghairal laahi taamurooonneee a'budu ayyuhal jaahiloon
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Is it other than Allah that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?"

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اُوۡحِيَ اِلَيۡكَ وَاِلَي الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَۚ لَئِنۡ اَشۡرَكۡتَ لَيَحۡبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad oohiya ilaika wa ilal lazeena min qablika la in ashrakta la yahbatanna 'amalu ka wa latakoonanna minal khaasireen
ayahs.en: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allah, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers."

ayahs.ar: بَلِ اللّٰهَ فَاعۡبُدۡ وَكُنۡ مِّنَ الشّٰكِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Balil laahha fa'bud wa kum minash shaakireen
ayahs.en: Rather, worship [only] Allah and be among the grateful.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ قَدۡرِهٖࣗۖ وَالۡاَرۡضُ جَمِيۡعًا قَبۡضَتُهٗ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ وَالسَّمٰوٰتُ مَطۡوِيّٰتٌۭ بِيَمِيۡنِهٖؕ سُبۡحٰنَهٗ وَتَعٰلٰي عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa qadarul laaha haqqa qadrihee wal ardu jamee 'an qabdatuhoo Yawmal Qiyaamit wassamaawaatu matwiyyaatum biyameenih; Subhaanahoo wa Ta'aalaa 'amma yushrikoon
ayahs.en: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.

ayahs.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّوۡرِ فَصَعِقَ مَنۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَنۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا مَنۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُؕ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيۡهِ اُخۡرٰي فَاِذَا هُمۡ قِيَامٌ يَّنۡظُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa nufikha fis Soori fas'iqa man fis samaawaati wa man fil ardi illaa man shaa'al lahu summa nufikha feehi ukhraa fa izaa hum qiyaamuny yanzuroon
ayahs.en: And the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom Allah wills. Then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on.

ayahs.ar: وَاَشۡرَقَتِ الۡاَرۡضُ بِنُوۡرِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ الۡكِتٰبُ وَجِايۡٓءَ بِالنَّبِيّٖنَ وَالشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ashraqatil ardu binoori Rabbihaa wa wudi'al Kitaabu wa jeee'a bin nabiyyeena wash shuhadaaa'i wa qudiya bainahum bilhaqqi wa hum laa yuzlamoon
ayahs.en: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the record [of deeds] will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged.

ayahs.ar: وَوُفِّيَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ وَهُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَفۡعَلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa wuffiyat kullu nafsim maa 'amilat wa Huwa a'lamubimaa yaf'aloon
ayahs.en: And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing of what they do.

ayahs.ar: وَسِيۡقَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اِلٰي جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًاؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا جَآءُوۡهَا فُتِحَتۡ اَبۡوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَا٘ اَلَمۡ يَاۡتِكُمۡ رُسُلٌ مِّنۡكُمۡ يَتۡلُوۡنَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّكُمۡ وَيُنۡذِرُوۡنَكُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هٰذَاؕ قَالُوۡا بَلٰي وَلٰكِنۡ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَةُ الۡعَذَابِ عَلَي الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa seeqal lazeena kafaroon ilaa jahannama zumaran battaaa izaa jaaa'oohaa futihat abwaabuhaa wa qaala lahum khazanatuhaaa alam yaatikum Rusulum minkum yatloona 'alaikum Aayaati Rabbikum wa yunziroonakum liqaaa'a Yawmikum haazaa; qaaloo balaa wa laakin haqqat kalimatul 'azaabi 'alal kaafireen
ayahs.en: And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups until, when they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers will say, "Did there not come to you messengers from yourselves, reciting to you the verses of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "Yes, but the word of punishment has come into effect upon the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: قِيۡلَ ادۡخُلُوۡ٘ا اَبۡوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاۚ فَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَي الۡمُتَكَبِّرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qeelad khuloo abwaaba jahannama khaalideena feeha fabi'sa maswal mutakabbireen
ayahs.en: [To them] it will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."

ayahs.ar: وَسِيۡقَ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡا رَبَّهُمۡ اِلَي الۡجَنَّةِ زُمَرًاؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا جَآءُوۡهَا وَفُتِحَتۡ اَبۡوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ طِبۡتُمۡ فَادۡخُلُوۡهَا خٰلِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa seeqal lazeenat taqaw Rabbahum ilal Jannati zumaran hattaaa izaa jaaa'oohaa wa futihat abwaabuhaa wa qaala lahum khazanatuhaa salaamun 'alaikum tibtum fadkhuloohaa khaalideen
ayahs.en: But those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups until, when they reach it while its gates have been opened and its keepers say, "Peace be upon you; you have become pure; so enter it to abide eternally therein," [they will enter].

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوا الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ صَدَقَنَا وَعۡدَهٗ وَاَوۡرَثَنَا الۡاَرۡضَ نَتَبَوَّاُ مِنَ الۡجَنَّةِ حَيۡثُ نَشَآءُۚ فَنِعۡمَ اَجۡرُ الۡعٰمِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa waalull hamdulillaahil lazee sadaqanaa wa'dahoo wa awrasanal arda natabaw wa-u minal jannati haisu nashaaa'u fani'ma ajrul 'aamileen
ayahs.en: And they will say, "Praise to Allah, who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth [so] we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of [righteous] workers."

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَي الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّيۡنَ مِنۡ حَوۡلِ الۡعَرۡشِ يُسَبِّحُوۡنَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡۚ وَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ وَقِيۡلَ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa taral malaaa'ikata haaaffeena min hawlil 'Arshi yusabbihoona bihamdi Rabbihim wa qudiya bainahum bilhaqqi wa qeelal hamdu lillaahi Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, exalting [Allah] with praise of their Lord. And it will be judged between them in truth, and it will be said, "[All] praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds."
